posts.title: Passive event listeners are a promise to the browser
posts.description: Passive event listeners let browsers scroll without waiting for JavaScript. The benefit comes from understanding what the listener gives up.

posts.title: Feature flags separate deployment from release
posts.description: Use feature flags to deploy incrementally, test with internal users and release gradually while keeping a way to disable new behavior.

posts.title: Named arguments in JavaScript
posts.description: Use object parameters to make function calls easier to read, distinguish values of the same type and expose boolean flags that deserve a better design.
